description: Create an email inbox for an AI agent to receive verification codes and magic links, in one call with no signup and no API key. Returns the address, a read_token (save it, it is shown once), the expiry time and an Ed25519 identity. Pass account_key to buy a longer-lived inbox with credits.

account_key.description: Optional account key (cak_...) to pay for a paid inbox. Without it the inbox is free and expires after 72 hours.

alias.description: Optional prefix for the address (lowercase letters, digits and dashes). A random suffix is always added, so the address cannot be guessed.

purpose.description: What the inbox is for, e.g. "verify my account on example.com". Optional, stored with the inbox.

ttl_hours.description: How many hours the inbox lives. 72 is free; 720 (30 days) needs an account_key with credits.

name: create_inbox
title: Create inbox
